description_en: Call DescribeDcdnIpaDomainDetail to get the basic configuration of a specified accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnIpaDomainDetail获取指定加速域名配置的基本信息
name: DescribeDcdnIpaDomainDetail

parameters.help_en: The domain name accelerated by IP Application Accelerator (IPA). You can query only one domain name at a time
parameters.help_zh: 接入全站加速IPA进行加速的域名，仅支持单个查询
parameters.name: domain_name

DomainDetail.description_en: The details of the domain name

CertName.description_en: The name of the certificate if HTTPS is enabled
CertName.description_zh: 如果开启HTTPS，此处为证书名称

Cname.description_en: The CNAME of the domain name

DomainName.description_en: The domain name that is accelerated by IPA
DomainName.description_zh: 接入全站加速IPA进行加速的域名

DomainStatus.description_en:
The status of the accelerated domain name. Valid values:

online: enabled.

offline: disabled.

configuring: configuring.

configure_failed: configuration failed.

checking: under review.

check_failed: review failed
DomainStatus.description_zh:
加速域名运行状态。取值：

online：启用。

offline：停用。

configuring：配置中。

configure_failed：配置失败。

checking：正在审核。

check_failed：审核失败

GmtCreated.description_en: The time when the domain name was created

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the domain name was last modified

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

SSLProtocol.description_en:
Indicates whether an SSL certificate is enabled. Valid values:

on: enabled.

off: disabled
SSLProtocol.description_zh:
是否开启SSL证书。取值：
on：开启。
off：关闭

SSLPub.description_en: The public key of the certificate if HTTPS is enabled
SSLPub.description_zh: 如果开启HTTPS，此处为证书公钥

Scope.description_en:
The acceleration region. Valid values:

domestic: the Chinese mainland only.

overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

global: global
Scope.description_zh:
加速区域。取值：

domestic：仅中国内地。

overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）。

global：全球

Source.description_en: The information about the origin server

Enabled.description_en: The status of the origin server

Port.description_en: A custom port. Valid values: 0 to 65535

Type.description_en:
The type of the origin server. Valid values:

ipaddr: an IP address.

domain: a domain name.

oss: an OSS bucket
Type.description_zh:
源站类型。取值：

ipaddr：IP源站。

domain：域名源站。

oss：不支持OSS

Weight.description_en: The weight of the origin server
